# WMM2025 test vectors

`WMM2025_TEST_VALUES.txt` contains the 100 published NOAA WMM2025 test vectors,
including their original field descriptions. Declination is published to 0.01°;
the test tolerance is 0.005° (half of the last published decimal place).

Model authority: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/world-magnetic-model

Retrieved from the pygeomag mirror at commit
`2b8ac57f08bc100ee1f103dbca4e1a8de65ff5e8`:
https://github.com/boxpet/pygeomag/blob/2b8ac57f08bc100ee1f103dbca4e1a8de65ff5e8/test/test_values/WMM2025_TEST_VALUES.txt

The expected values are stored independently of the installed pygeomag package;
they are not generated by the implementation being tested. Tests do not download
data or contact a magnetic-field API.
